name: What is the process for getting new flooring installed by City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting new flooring installed by City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your needs and preferences. Next, we schedule an on-site visit to accurately measure the area, assess the subfloor, and provide a detailed, itemized quote. Once you approve the quote and select materials, we coordinate the delivery and schedule the installation. Our team handles all aspects, including old flooring removal, subfloor preparation, installation, and final cleanup, ensuring minimal disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, on-site measurement and quote, material selection, scheduling, and professional installation including preparation and cleanup.
